what: M8 team ratings from earlier games only, and whether they predict beyond the pregame spread (scripts/m8_team_strength.py)

evaluation_plan.residual_bases: fitted on development seasons 2010-2023 for both test seasons
evaluation_plan.ratings: pre-game, from the filter run forward through the test seasons with the frozen constants (online updating, no refit)
evaluation_plan.comparison: mean log loss per row, primary minus spread_only, 95% interval from 2000 resamples of test-season games
evaluation_plan.conversion_rows: third and fourth downs, 1 to 3 to go, runs and passes
evaluation_plan.drive_rows: regulation drives starting with more than 120 s left in the half
evaluation_plan.reading: an interval entirely below 0 is an improvement; an interval that includes 0, or a mean within 0.001 of 0, means the spread already carries what the ratings know
